items.detail: PubChem descriptions retrieved live once to shared immutable tool cache for119 metadata compounds. Agents choose <=5 donor descriptions to disclose per query. This tests source-qualified retrieval/disclosure from a fixed corpus, not autonomous novel corpus search or differential network cost. Deterministic lexical baseline has broader description access, making it a strong information baseline.
Reference A375 mean imputes missing visible anchor features; reference-only complete features determine model axis. No target imputation and no outcome-based query removal.
Preserved preparation receipts record bounded network read retry, separate test_anchor output, and explicit DMSO metadata 0.1 percent variants. No scientific endpoint changes.
One stochastic agent realization per query/arm, no repeated-seed biological claims.20 independent connectivity groups for final comparison; low power and preprocessing cohort QC limitations apply.
